The ClimaVue 40 is intended for year-round, unattended outdoor use in meteorological and environmental monitoring applications. It tolerates continuous exposure to wind, heavy rain, dust, and solar radiation. This device should not be subjected to high-pressure water streams, submersion in liquid, or corrosive gases.
